verdict.rationale: Reducto documents dedicated table output formats and says the chosen format determines how merged cells, headers, and structure are represented. Parse explicitly handles nested tables, and the CLI writes markdown (.parse.md) output, so the core of faithful complex-table structure is covered. missing for 10: evidence of tables spanning multiple pages being stitched together, explicit confirmation that HTML is one of the output formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration of table fidelity.
